title: 第7章 肆意妄为第8章 齐家兄妹
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 齐格飞挂着笑容，一边翻阅着漫游手册，一边缓步走向自己的工位。
换成往常，他不会去管这种事，不仅没有好处还会给自己惹麻烦。
风险和收益根本不成正比。
但如今，他非常乐意用漫游手册和意能把这个恶心的胖子除掉。
齐格飞的声音并不大也没什么情绪波动，就像是寻常的招呼。
可偏偏话里话外的阴阳怪气扎人心扉，像是一记响亮的耳光扇的人脸颊生疼。
杨静明亮的双眼微睁，表情有些错愕。
印象里从她入职那天起这个男人和自己就只有少量必要的交流，怎么会突然帮自己出头？
（他的性格是不是变了？）
张总一时间被噎得上不去下不来，脸色青一阵红一阵，只得悻悻地把咸猪手收了回来。
他扫了一眼面容清秀的齐格飞，不自觉地皱了皱眉头。
如果说普通员工里还有谁敢和他叫板，那就只有眼前这位了。
原因无他，齐格飞也是通过某个高层的介绍进入的公司。和他不同是，齐格飞选择从基层干起而他张总则直接坐上了领导的位置。
单论职位，他还在齐格飞之上。所以哪怕是为了面子他也不能示弱。
“我当是谁，原来是小齐啊。”张总上上下下大量着齐格飞，口中发出啧啧啧的声音：“不愧是谢老总的侄子，真是一表人才啊。谢老总最近还好吗？”
这位谢老总是齐格飞父亲的挚友，担任这家电气公司的法律顾问的同时也是股东之一。
六年前齐格飞的父母死于一场突如其来的意外后，一直都是这位谢叔叔在照顾齐家的兄妹。
张总心里虽然有一万个不爽，但还得露出笑脸，毕竟这位谢老总在董事会的话语权甚至在他的姐夫之上。
他只能通过这种明褒暗讽的方式提醒齐格飞，你也是个关系户，别自讨没趣。
“承蒙关怀，我叔叔身强体壮，倒是张总您眼窝发黑、脸色虚浮，工作，辛苦了。”
可齐格飞似乎完全没有听出张总话里的意思，毫不客气地反唇相讥，尤其是在“工作”这两个字上加了重音。
张总眼神阴沉了下来，同为关系户，他没想到齐格飞居然这么不给面子。
但作为混迹职场的老油条，他很快就控制了情绪，语气无奈地道：
“哎，那些大老板太难应付，我实在力不从心。诶？小齐你能力那么强要不我把订单让给你，你去和客户协商，我跟着你学习经验，好不好~”
张总拉着长音，大脸上又露出了油腻的笑容。
随着这句话的回荡，整个办公室的火药味顿时就浓重了起来。
办公室里的其他人都把脑袋深深地埋了下去，只抬起一只眼偷偷地看着这个方向。
他们的心里都希望儒雅清秀，为人随和的齐格飞能够在这场对峙中占据上风。
可张总不仅官高一级，还有多出齐格飞二十年的职场经验，显然不是这个年轻人能对付的。
“额，张总，小齐他也来公司也没多久，这种大订单他哪能做啊？”
坐在齐格飞对面，和他私交甚笃的前辈大哥看不下去了，急忙出面当和事老，使劲地向他这位冲头后辈使眼色。
可齐格飞依旧像是无事人一样盯着手里的漫游手册，自始至终他都没有抬头瞧过张总一眼。
content_en:
Siegfried smiled, flipping through the roaming manual, and walked slowly towards his work station.
Normally, he wouldn't have cared about this kind of thing. Not only would it be of no benefit, but it would also cause trouble for himself.
Risks and returns are simply not proportional.
But now, he's more than happy to use the Hitchhiker's Manual and his powers to get rid of this disgusting fat man.
Siegfried's voice was neither loud nor emotional, just like a normal greeting.
But the strangeness inside and outside the words hurt people's hearts, like a loud slap in the face that hurts someone's cheek.
Yang Jing's bright eyes opened slightly, her expression a little stunned.
In her impression, this man had only had a small amount of necessary communication with her since the day she joined the company. How could he suddenly help her out?
(Has his personality changed?)
Mr. Zhang was choked for a while and couldn't go up or down. His face turned green and red, and he had to withdraw his hands angrily.
He glanced at Siegfried, who had a delicate face, and frowned unconsciously.
If there is anyone among ordinary employees who dares to challenge him, it is only the person in front of him.
There was no other reason. Siegfried also entered the company through the introduction of a senior executive. Unlike him, Siegfried chose to work from the grassroots level while he, Mr. Zhang, directly took the leadership position.
In terms of position alone, he is still above Siegfried. So even for the sake of face, he couldn't show weakness.
"Who do I think it is? It turns out to be Xiao Qi." Mr. Zhang looked at Siegfried up and down, and made a tut-tutting sound in his mouth: "As expected of Mr. Xie's nephew, he is such a talented person. How are you doing, Mr. Xie recently?"
Mr. Xie was a close friend of Siegfried's father. He served as the legal advisor of the electrical company and was also one of the shareholders.
After Siegfried's parents died in a sudden accident six years ago, it was Uncle Xie who had been taking care of the Qi family's siblings.
Although Mr. Zhang was unhappy, he still had to smile. After all, Mr. Xie had even more say in the board of directors than his brother-in-law.
He could only remind Siegfried through explicit praise and implicit sarcasm that you are also a person with connections, so don’t bring trouble to yourself.
"Thanks to your care, my uncle is strong and strong, but Mr. Zhang, you have dark eye sockets and a pale face. You have worked hard."
But Siegfried didn't seem to understand the meaning of Mr. Zhang's words at all, and retorted rudely, especially the emphasis on the word "work".
Mr. Zhang's eyes darkened. As they were both related, he didn't expect Siegfried to be so disrespectful.
But as a veteran in the workplace, he quickly controlled his emotions and said helplessly:
"Hey, those big bosses are too difficult to deal with, and I am really beyond my capabilities. Eh? Xiao Qi, you are so capable, why don't I give you the order, and you go negotiate with the customer, and I will learn from your experience, okay~"
Mr. Zhang made a long note, and a greasy smile appeared on his big face.
As these words echoed, the smell of gunpowder in the entire office suddenly became stronger.
Everyone else in the office buried their heads deeply, only raising one eye to secretly look in this direction.
In their hearts, they all hope that Siegfried, who is elegant, comely, and easy-going, can gain the upper hand in this confrontation.
But Mr. Zhang is not only a senior official, but also has twenty years more workplace experience than Siegfried. It is obviously not something this young man can handle.
"Well, Mr. Zhang, Xiao Qi has only been in the company for a short time. How can he do such a big order?"
Sitting opposite Siegfried, his senior brother, who had a close personal relationship with him, couldn't stand it any longer. He hurriedly stepped forward to act as peacemaker and winked at his young junior.
But Siegfried was still staring at the Hitchhiker's Manual in his hand as if nothing had happened. He never raised his head to glance at Mr. Zhang from beginning to end.
